s.how: Drain 300g pickled herring and cut into bite pieces. Mix with 150g sour cream, chopped dill and half a thinly sliced red onion. Butter 6 slices dark rye, cut into squares and spoon the herring on top.

s.note: the Georgian dealer Danko chases all the way to Chicago
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 4 ovals, fill with 200g mozzarella mixed with 200g crumbled feta and fold the edges into boat shapes. Bake at 230C for 12 minutes, crack an egg into each and bake 4 minutes more. Add a knob of butter and stir at the table.

m.note: Danko's partner, who talks all the way through dinner
m.how: Sear 600g eye fillet strips fast in batches and set aside. Brown 300g mushrooms and 1 onion, add 1 tsp paprika, 1 tbsp Dijon and 250ml stock and reduce. Stir in 200g sour cream off the heat, add the beef back. Serve over 400g egg noodles.

w.note: Russian layers for the Soviet cop
w.how: Melt 100g honey, 100g butter and 150g sugar, whisk in 3 eggs and 1 tsp bicarb, then 450g flour. Roll into 8 thin discs and bake each 6 minutes at 180C. Layer with 600g sour cream beaten with 395g condensed milk. Coat in crumbs and rest overnight.

d.n: Danko's cranberry mors and vodka cooler
d.note: a taste of home for the Soviet cop
d.how: Simmer 300g frozen cranberries with 600ml water and 4 tbsp honey for 10 minutes, crushing the berries. Strain, add the juice of 1 lemon and chill. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 40ml vodka and 120ml mors to each, top with 60ml soda water and stir. Garnish with a few frozen cranberries and a lemon slice.
